en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a narrow valley surrounded by wooded hills. A prominent Baroque-style church with an onion-shaped spire and clock tower stands on a slope to the right, partly obscured by trees. Below and to the left runs a curving main street lined with 3–4 story masonry houses with steep roofs and dormer windows. A narrow stream parallels the road in the foreground, and terraced buildings and paths are visible climbing the hillside in the background. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century central European spa or hillside town.
